firstPlayerRule: Players pick cards to choose the dealer; the highest number deals and special cards don’t count. The player to the left of the dealer starts play.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest number, those players pick again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Mattel service-site instruction PDF and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 3: "...number deals. If you picked a Special Card, too bad – they don’t count." "The dealer deals 7 cards to each player, starts the Discard pile ..., then loads the Launcher." "Player to the left of dealer starts play." © 2002 Mattel.
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal high picks.
